column1: Shohei Ohtani leads the slate with a strong combination of steady contact rates and a favorable matchup, batting leadoff with the platoon advantage against Tomoyuki Sugano in a hitter-friendly park. Freddie Freeman also profiles well near the top of the order, offering similar reliability despite a recent dip in hits. Luis Arraez brings excellent consistency at home, while Otto Lopez and Andy Pages round out the top options with solid but less compelling profiles today.
